_doc: Third Kimodo batch: arm postures for the pose layer (in place, retarget with :idle :loop).
The layer takes only the arms from these, so the legs are irrelevant; what matters is
that the arms keep moving — reaching and grasping at something in front, or raised high
and grabbing at the air — the way a chasing zombie's would. Same frame conventions as clips.json.

clips.name: k_arms_grab
clips.note: chase/hold arms: reaching forward and grasping at someone just out of reach (in place)
prompts: A zombie stands in place reaching forward with both arms and grasping at someone just out of reach opening and closing its hands
A zombie stands in place lunging with its arms again and again trying to grab someone in front of it

clips.name: k_arms_high
clips.note: hyper chase arms: raised high, frantic grabbing at the air (in place)
prompts: A zombie stands in place with both arms raised high above its head frantically grabbing and clawing at the air
A furious zombie stands in place waving both raised arms wildly and clawing at the air
